speech:
Grizzly Rips, that was an F. Four matches, 4 losses, and we got relegated. We walked in this morning sitting in Division 3 and we're walking out in Division 4. We scored 6 and let in 14. That's 3.5 goals conceded every single match. We usually pick up 1.51 points a match. Today we picked up zero, and we didn't earn a single point in either half of anything. The other side averaged an 8.62 rating to our 7.66. We didn't just lose, we got outplayed.

Gilbertstein beat us 0-3 to start the day, and we didn't even register a shot between the 2 of you. Then aztecuba put 4 past us, 1-4, and that burned our last chance in Division 3. Then we had a relegation match against Team Takeoff, a match where everything was on the line, and we let in 4 again and lost 3-4. Yesterday was a D-minus. Today we went lower.

BellyTb1, that first match was a no-show. You attempted 0 passes when you usually try 28. You took 0 shots when you usually take 4. Their best forward put up a 9.7 while you sat at a 6.5. Across the day you took 7 shots and only got 2 on target, and you lost 4 of your 7 tackles. You averaged a 7.75 against your usual 8.23. Now, credit where it's due: you woke up late. You had 2 goals and 3 assists, an 8.9 in the last match, and 3 key passes against Team Takeoff when you normally make 1. But that only shows what we were missing in match 1.

PhogsToffees, same disappearing act in match 1. You made 12 pass attempts when you usually make 35, you took 0 shots, and you got the same 6.5 against that same 9.7 forward. You won just 2 of your 8 tackles, which is 25%. You averaged 7.58 when your usual is 8.17. You did score 4 goals, you finished 67% of your chances against Team Takeoff, and you hit an 8.7 against SÖMBRA. That's a real finisher in there. But 4 goals don't matter much when we let in 14.

Here's the fix, and it's simple. Shoot from the middle of the box. Set your feet before you pull the trigger. If you've got a tight angle, cut it back to your partner, because a better shot beats a first shot.

Now come here a second. When I was a kid, our barn roof caved in under a heavy snow. My daddy didn't cuss at the sky. He grabbed a hammer and said, "Well, now we get to build it stronger." That's where we are. And here's what I saw that didn't get counted on the scoreboard. Nobody quit. Not one rage quit in four straight losses. Y'all stayed in it, and those last 2 matches were one-goal losses. You're 2 players who've played over 140 matches together, and you're 29 and 24 on the season.

Division 4 is just a place to start rebuilding. We need 9 points to get back to Division 3, and we've got 3 chances to get them. Tomorrow we come out swinging, hammers in hand, and we build this thing stronger than it ever was. I believe in you both, and I'll see you out there.
